proposal.title: Convert Tandy Model II FlexiBUS option to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: Tandy Model II FlexiBUS option
before.description: A Model II-specific internal FlexiBUS option with a two-port configuration subject to slot, power, timing and attachment qualification. It uses the Tandy Model II bus, is not S-100 compatible and retains Tandy’s native video and existing interfaces. Powered-on attachment is permitted only on a qualified quiescent port. Initial supply uses AION chips; SMC substitution requires per-part qualification.

specification.description: Tandy sells and supports the qualified Model II option.

specification.description: The internal option is specific to the Model II host bus.
